evidence.name: MainGameTickUpdate

function_ir.summary: Per-frame main game tick: converts session time (dbl_8AFEA0 * 400) into a tick counter, then runs a fixed tick loop dispatching per-tick and per-multiple-of-10 subsystems — AI updates, vehicle physics dispatch, particle effects, fuel/wear, tire forces, yaw recovery, debug logging — interleaved on tick parity and modulo windows. Wraps the tick counter every 400 ticks, runs the driver input controller when its gate is set, and finishes by returning the per-vehicle camera update iterator result.

local_names.v3: adjusted starting tick counter (clamped to target - 201)

operations.description: Entry gate: when dword_8AB6E4 == 2 the entire tick body is skipped and control falls to the camera-iterator return.

Compute the target tick count: v1 = dbl_8AFEA0 * 400.0; feed it to sub_5895A2 and convert with CRTFtol; clamp the counter dword_7C5694 so the pending delta never exceeds 201 ticks (v3 = v2 - 201, dword_7C5694 = v2 - 201).
Tick loop: v15 starts at dword_7C5694 * 0.0025 and advances by 0.0025 each iteration; the loop runs while dword_7C5694 stays below the target v2.

Odd-tick physics dispatch: when dword_7C5698 % 10 is non-zero, and the player vehicle (dword_7C54E8) has no pause flag at +13000, and either dword_7CE958 is clear or the tick parity is even, and the +18620 flag has bit 8 set, call VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher(v15).
10-tick AI pass: for each of dword_5C329C vehicles in the dword_7C54F0 array call AIMainUpdate(veh); then LoopWithConditionalSkipFunction(dword_5EA560, v15).
Zero the twelve scoring/stewarding accumulators dword_7C932C through dword_7C9354 and seed the loop counter dword_7C9358.
Particle/effect pass over dword_5C329C vehicles in dword_7C54F0: call ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch(veh+12) for each, then sub_4EE2D0(veh+12) for each.
Fuel/wear window: every 400 ticks (dword_7C5698 % 400 == 0), for vehicles whose +13000 flag equals 1, call FuelConsumptionAndWear(1.0).

Tire/lateral window: every 50 ticks (dword_7C5698 % 50 == 0) run AILateralForceComputation(this), VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController(0.125) for every vehicle, and WheelTireForceUpdate(0.125) for vehicles with the +13000 flag set.
When the player vehicle's +13000 flag is clear, call sub_4BCCC0(0.025).
Periodic debug log: every dword_8AD23C ticks call DebugLogInit(&dword_8AD238) when dword_8AD238 is set; on the very first tick (dword_7C5698 == 0) also run sub_4D59B0(&dword_8AD238).
Tick wrap: increment dword_7C5698, reset it to 0 when it reaches 400, increment dword_7C5694, and continue the loop while dword_7C5694 < target v2.
Post-loop input: when dword_7CBF24 is set, call DriverInputController(&unk_7CBB10).

unresolved: The offset literals +13000 and +18620 applied to the player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E8 are direct source literals with no enumerated field evidence refs; their semantics (pause flag, race-state flag) are DERIVED from existing analysis only.
The read-only doubles dbl_59E9B0 and dbl_59E9D8 are listed as read by this function but are folded into FPU literals by Hex-Rays and never appear by name in the .c.
The object passed to AILateralForceComputation and to the camera iterator (dword_5EA560, and `this` for the lateral computation) is an unproven global instance identity.
